title: Gated-SCNN: Gated Shape CNNs for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: A full-resolution shape stream, gated by the main stream and supervised with boundaries, runs in parallel with the regular segmentation stream.
adaptation: A shape stream at 512 px gated by U-Net++ encoder features, with boundary targets as in SBCB (crack band excluded). Run only if the SBCB arm helps the thin structure classes.
min_experiment: Arm: house + shape stream. Baseline: house. Metrics: gridline and edge_dark IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill if the gain is < 0.01 mIoU_rob over the SBCB arm.
evidence: R: Cityscapes mIoU +2 and boundary F +4 over strong baselines. The abstract claims larger gains on thinner, smaller objects.
